newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Citibank, NatWest in Randalls Food loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Citibank, NatWest in Randalls Food loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, April 22 (LPC) - Citicorp's Citibank and NatWest Markets will co-arrange Texas Commerce Bank's roughly $325 million loan backing Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co's acquisition of a majority stake in Randalls Food Markets, market sources said.
Meanwhile, BT Securities, a unit of Bankers Trust Corp, will lead a high-yield bond offering of roughly $150 million, sources said.

Though terms still were developing, the senior debt deal was expected to be split between a $225 million revolver and a $100 million term loan, sources said. The deal will be launched with a bank meeting in May, they added.
Randalls Food Marekts is a Houston-based grocery store operator.
